description: This file provides an API for mapping symbols through OMAP information in Windows debugging, including functions to extract OMAP data, build image maps, and map address ranges. It defines functions and includes internal headers related to OMAP processing.

methods.name: GetOmapDataAndDisableTranslation
methods.description: Extracts OMAP data from a session and disables automatic translation.

methods.name: BuildImageMap
methods.description: Builds an image map from raw OMAP data for address translation queries.

methods.name: MapAddressRange
methods.description: Determines how an address range in the original image has been transformed.
